fusions.name: Headlong Ram
fusions.desc: You rush an enemy up to 6 tiles away and ram it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Won't Be Moved
fusions.desc: Plants your feet and slams the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring armour. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Unmoved
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
